text_block_list.text:
"A narrow tie! Everyone gave a wonderful 
performance, but you were just one step 
away~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I must put forth my utmost effort toward 
our next victory...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I'm going to go 
redesign the clubroom's interior right 
away!
